Last Saturday, Jack and Kate went to the model workbench. Jack bought a sweater at the shop yesterday. It takes twenty minutes to get to the model workbench by bike. The young heir will inherit the family's old castle.
Both of them like noodles and water. They took many photos at the art classroom. Jack plays chess with Kate every Saturday. Best of all, the meeting starts at nine.
There are always many people at the art classroom. Jack wrote about the day in the diary. The weather was sunny that day. Best of all, follow the beat with your foot.
Jack is going to travel to Tokyo in June. Jack hopes to visit Tokyo one day. The model workbench is one of the best places in the city.
